d: Six members (5 employees + manager) press 'Odoslať' at the same moment in six browsers
pre: all six on the comment step of the same round
steps: click Odoslať in all six pages concurrently
exp: six thank-you screens; 6 participations, 6 responses; multiset of stored values equals the inputs

d: The same user in two tabs submits the same round at the same moment
pre: new round; Adam has the wizard on the comment step in two tabs with different answers
steps: click Odoslať in both tabs concurrently
exp: one tab: thank-you; the other: 'Toto kolo už máš vyplnené'; exactly 1 participation and 1 response

d: Ten parallel API submissions of the same user
steps: 10× POST /api/rounds/:id/responses at once
exp: exactly one 201, nine 409 already_submitted, no 500; 1 participation, 1 response

d: Twelve users of two teams submit to their own rounds in parallel (API)
steps: 12 parallel POSTs (6 Alfa, 6 Beta)
exp: 12× 201; each round 6/6; no cross-team rows

d: A member of another team submits to a foreign round while it is open
steps: Filip (Beta): POST response to the Alfa round
exp: 403; nothing stored (data isolation)

d: The manager closes the round while a member is on the last step
pre: new open round; Cyril on the comment step
steps: manager clicks 'Uzavrieť' in /rounds; Cyril clicks Odoslať
exp: Cyril sees 'Kolo je uzavreté'; nothing stored; manager's list shows 'Uzavreté'

d: Race: close and five submissions fired together (repeated 3×)
steps: Promise.all([close, 5 responses]) for each round
exp: every response is either 201 or 409 round_closed; participations = responses in each round; results count equals stored rows; no 500

d: HR and the manager both press 'Spustiť' on the same draft at the same time
steps: click Spustiť in both browsers concurrently
exp: DB OPEN with one startsAt; one side may show 'Kolo medzitým zmenilo stav. Obnov stránku.'; no crash
actual: DB=OPEN; messages=["Kolo medzitým zmenilo stav. Obnov stránku."]; page errors=0

d: HR and the manager both press 'Uzavrieť' at the same time
pre: the round from the previous step is open in both lists
steps: reload both lists; click Uzavrieť in both concurrently
exp: DB CLOSED once (single closedAt); loser sees the 'changed state' message
actual: DB=CLOSED, closedAt=2026-11-12T16:13:06.771Z; messages=["Kolo medzitým zmenilo stav. Obnov stránku."]

d: Two parallel close requests through the API
steps: HR and manager: POST close at once
exp: one 200 and one 409 invalid_state

d: Automatic close: several users load pages at the same moment after the deadline
pre: open round with its deadline moved 1 minute into the past in the QA DB
steps: 6 parallel GETs (home pages + API) by different users
exp: round CLOSED with closedAt = deadline; all requests 200

d: Action status changed in two tabs of the manager
pre: closed Beta round with one action 'Plánované'; results page open in two tabs
steps: tab 1: set 'Hotové'; tab 2 (still showing 'Plánované'): set 'Prebieha'; then look at tab 1 without reloading and after reloading
exp: last write wins in the DB (IN_PROGRESS); after reload both tabs agree with the DB
actual: tab 2 before its change showed=PLANNED; DB=IN_PROGRESS; tab 1 without reload still shows=DONE (stale, no warning); tab 1 after reload=IN_PROGRESS

d: Two parallel PATCHes of the same action
steps: PATCH DONE and PATCH PLANNED at once
exp: both 200; DB holds one of the two valid values
